SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
SECRET REPORT
C.S.C, Special Branch Section,
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 9987 (c)
Date December 15, 1938.

Subject Germany and Italy to open Diplomatic Dealings with the Reformed
Government - rumoured.

Made by ____ and ____ Forwarded by Inspector Papp.

It is rumoured that Marquis F.M.Taliani de
Marchio, the Italian Ambassador and Dr. E.Fracklo, the German
Charge'd'Affaires, have recently made arrangements with the
Japanese authorities for the opening of diplomatic relations
with the Reformed Government at Nanking. As a result of
this arrangement, the Reformed Government will allow Italy
and Germany to re-open their consulates at Nanking and
Kiukiang. It is stated that consular representatives of
these two nations have already left for the afore-named
cities to arrange for the re-opening of their consulates,
which, it is expected, will begin to function early next
year.

It is also learned that in order to show their
appreciation of the friendly gestures manifested by these
two nations, the Reformed Government authorities are prepared
to grant special privileges to Italian and German nationals
engaged in business in the area under their administration.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 16 DEC. 1938）

编号：S. B. D. 9987 (c)
日期：1938年12月15日。

主题：传闻德国和意大利将与维新政府建立外交关系。

由 ____ 和 ____ 撰写，由帕普（Papp）巡官呈报。

据传，意大利大使塔利亚尼·迪·马尔基奥侯爵（Marquis F.M. Taliani de Marchio）与德国代办弗拉克洛博士（Dr. E. Fracklo）最近已与日本当局作出安排，以便与南京的维新政府建立外交关系。作为此项安排的结果，维新政府将允许意大利和德国重新开放其在南京和九江的领事馆。据悉，这两国的领事代表已启程前往上述城市，着手安排重新开放领事馆事宜，预计领事馆将于明年初开始运作。

另获悉，为了表示对这两国所表现出的友好姿态的赞赏，维新政府当局准备给予在其管辖区域内从事商业活动的意大利和德国国民以特别特权。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处处长办公室 1938年12月16日）
